subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be documentation/help for the current pi-tui behavior only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but a configurable preference would add public TUI config or CLI surface under a repository policy that sets a high bar for new config options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow keybinding config or CLI surface with docs and tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Split Broader Composer Requests
options.body: Keep this issue focused on TUI inline behavior and route WebChat shortcuts, external-editor handoff, and vi-mode work to their separate trackers.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest direct signal from the prior review and current TUI wrapper/docs/help history.
